_approach: Classic Motor City 909 groove: a four-to-the-floor kick, a snare pitched down and a rimshot both placed as counterpoint that steps around the kick rather than reinforcing it, and hi-hats built from a sharp closed layer plus an open hat firing on every off-beat 8th. MPC-style swing (~57%) gives the shuffle Attack's Motor City Techno dissection describes; dynamics come from the interplay of the layers, not from processing. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
